title: WP0.7 — Audit publication, withdrawal, and privacy inheritance
description:
## Decision

Owned by cli/ and platform/. v0.2 extends the shipped v0.1 publication, server receipt, idempotence, signed withdrawal, tombstone, and private-evidence contracts. Withdrawal hides normal discovery but preserves the direct withdrawn page and immutable evidence. Billing-principal labels stay private unless publication intent explicitly opts in.

## Rationale

One inherited protocol preserves offline and append-only guarantees while letting WP5 add evidence facets. The visibility rule provides practical withdrawal without pretending immutable evidence was deleted.

## Alternatives Considered

A parallel v0.2 publication protocol, destructive deletion, always-public billing labels, and a platform run controller were rejected.

## Required Skills

ash-regents
acceptance_criteria: PUBLICATION_WITHDRAWAL_AUDIT.md names the inherited write contracts and the exact WP5 additions; proof bytes and accepted receipts remain immutable; withdrawn entries are absent from index/search/feed but retain a direct withdrawn page and tombstone; default public billing disclosure is omitted; no platform run controller, v0.2 facet persistence, or replacement publication path is implemented in WP0.

title: WP0.8 — Freeze the proposed lock and prepare founder approval
description: Cross-component closeout. Reconcile every active v0.2 ticket to exactly one work package; assemble the exact tested Verifiers, Prime, Fabric, Relay, environment, capability, fixture, plugin-boundary, publication, and release-identity artifacts; replace pending fields only with evidence-backed values; prepare the final founder approval packet. The lock remains proposed until Sean approves its exact digest.
acceptance_criteria: All WP0 children satisfy their exit contracts; UPSTREAM_CONTRACT_LOCK.json and FABRIC_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.json contain no unresolved production field; every coordinate and fixture has a digest and source; the Prime organization owner is @techtree with the private display label Regents Labs; protected actions and known limitations are itemized; the approval packet requests one exact digest; no production integration or final lock adoption is claimed before approval.

title: WP0.6 — Lock the machine contract and multi-plugin packaging map
description:
## Decision

Owned by cli/ and plugin/. The CLI owns one versioned machine contract and all scientific and durable state. Host integrations are thin independent consumers. WP0 records the target plugin/hermes and plugin/codex layout, preserves the current Hermes public package contract, adds no shared runtime SDK, and does not physically move the plugin.

## Rationale

A schema boundary lets more host integrations reuse Techtree without duplicating schedulers, receipts, approvals, provider clients, or publication rules. Deferring the physical move prevents a planning ticket from breaking the released Hermes installation.

## Alternatives Considered

A shared plugin SDK and independent per-host scientific implementations were rejected as premature duplication. Leaving plugin/ permanently Hermes-specific was rejected because Codex is stable v0.2 scope.
acceptance_criteria: MACHINE_CONTRACT.md and PLUGIN_LAYOUT.md define one versioned JSON envelope and fixed operation inventory; both host packages are thin independent consumers; no plugin owns a scheduler, receipt, provider client, approval rule, or publication implementation; no empty preview package or plugin/common runtime is introduced; the current Hermes compatibility requirements are explicit; WP0 does not physically move the plugin.

title: WP0.4 — Lock Fabric Hermes and Codex adapter capabilities
description:
## Goal

Owned by cli/ with plugin/ as a consumer. Discover exact stable Fabric runtime, schema, Hermes adapter, and Codex adapter candidates; capture descriptors and discovery provenance; exercise real admission and isolation checks in CLI-owned managed environments; record claimed, observed, unsupported, and release-admitted capabilities without modifying normal Hermes or Codex installations.

## Findings

Pending. The current capability matrix admits no adapter. Record descriptor claims, real conformance results, unsupported requirements, isolation evidence, and the separate founder admission decision.
acceptance_criteria: Exact runtime/schema/adapter coordinates and descriptor digests exist; capability entries distinguish descriptor claims, Techtree conformance, and founder release admission; unsupported normalized controls fail admission before spend; host Hermes and Codex installations and config remain unchanged; no reusable credential or unrelated environment secret is copied into the managed runtime.

title: WP0.2 — Lock the Verifiers candidate and deterministic environment contract
description:
## Goal

Owned by cli/. Discover the newest official stable Verifiers release first and capture exact source and artifact coordinates. Retain verifiers 0.3.2.dev17 only as an explicitly allowed fallback spike candidate. Define and locally exercise the tiny deterministic Techtree Prime conformance environment without publishing it, using fixed task identities, a deterministic scorer, no network, no secrets, no judge model, and no performance claim.

## Findings

Pending. Record the stable candidate, fallback result, exact coordinates, deterministic environment digests, and local conformance evidence. A proposal is not an adopted lock.
acceptance_criteria: Stable and fallback candidate records use explicit discovered/spike/passed/proposed states; exact source, version, commit, artifact digest, task membership, scorer, and package digests exist; the local environment conformance check passes; no lock uses latest, main, or an unbounded version; no environment is published.

title: WP0.3 — Capture the Prime Hosted Evaluations contract
description:
## Goal

Owned by cli/. Exercise only an official public SDK or official CLI machine surface. Capture sanitized, bounded fixtures for account/team discovery, create, get, list, samples/results, logs, stop, pagination, and terminal failure; prove immutable environment selection, provider status vocabulary, result availability, billing-principal representation, cancellation, and any idempotency guarantee. Use the founder-selected Prime organization @techtree, displayed locally as Regents Labs, and prepare exact protected action packets; do not publish or start a paid run.

## Findings

Q14 is resolved: the organization slug is techtree and the private operator label is Regents Labs. Team IDs, user IDs, emails, and provider-internal identifiers are excluded from fixtures and public evidence. All remaining findings are pending conformance. Unsupported behavior must be recorded rather than invented.
acceptance_criteria: The supported Prime interface and exact client/API coordinates are recorded; every response shape required by WP4 has a sanitized fixture or an explicit unsupported finding; private account identifiers and credentials are absent; provider idempotency is proved or explicitly unproven; the conformance environment is prepared for techtree/techtree-v02-conformance; publication and paid-run actions remain blocked behind exact founder approval.

This ticket may correct the mistaken selector implementation, but it does not add a replacement release filter.

acceptance_criteria: RETROSPECTIVE.md and RELEASE_IDENTITY.md state the exact v0.2 identity and permanent completion rules; no Climb identifier is treated as product-release provenance; public scope copy agrees with docs/plan/v0.2.md; focused platform regression checks pass; the completion record links exact commits and verification evidence.
close_reason: Acceptance met in d30c5747575acf6a104b175524cdb935647eed51; focused and full platform gates pass; adversarial re-review has no remaining P0-P2 findings.

title: WP0.5 — Lock Relay, ATOF, ATIF, and coverage profiles
description:
## Goal

Owned by cli/. Discover exact stable Relay, ATOF, and ATIF coordinates; capture bounded local-file ATOF and derived ATIF fixtures; draft adapter-specific Hermes and Codex coverage profiles; document registration, correlation, teardown, flush, dropped-event, hard-death, size-bound, and incomplete/unavailable semantics. Relay remains observe-only and has no streaming service or public raw-trace path.

## Findings

Pending. Record exact coordinates, local-file fixtures, profile expectations, delivery and teardown behavior, size bounds, and failure classifications. No finding may promote Relay into score or spend authority.
acceptance_criteria: Exact package/schema coordinates and fixture digests exist; profile drafts derive expected events from declared sources; not-requested, unavailable, incomplete, and complete-for-profile are unambiguous; teardown and dropped-event findings are recorded; local raw ATOF/ATIF remain private; no score, spend, or execution decision depends on Relay.
